newsitem.title: CHINA: Shanghai Waigaoqiao 1996 net profit up.
newsitem.headline: Shanghai Waigaoqiao 1996 net profit up.

text.p: Property company Shanghai Waigaoqiao Free Trade Zone Development Co Ltd said on Saturday its 1996 net profit was 95.742 million yuan under international accounting standards, up from 75.201 million in 1995.
Waigaoqiao said an improved investment climate and progress in the development of the zone helped support profits, according to the company's annual report, published in the Shanghai Securities News.
Based on domestic accounting standards, Waigaoqiao's net profit fell 6.03 percent to 113.899 million yuan in 1996, from 121.208 million in 1995, it said.
The company's board of directors have proposed a cash dividend of 0.10 yuan per share, as well as a three-for-10 bonus issue pending approval at a shareholders meeting on June 10, the report said.
The Waigaoqiao zone is part of Shanghai's Pudong New Area, which the government is promoting as China's premier site for trade, financial and industrial development.
